_comment: Mobile Android regression. TWO-STEP RUN — the API only reproduces step 1. Step 1 (this spec) = Folder Mobile + Active + Regression/Smoke, excluding automation types Automated(10) and Automated-Android(23) → 191 cases as of 2026-07-22. STEP 2 IS MANUAL: after creating this run, in the Testmo UI clear the filters, select Configuration = iOS, and REMOVE those from the run to reach the net ~154.
